description: Explicit product-lifecycle framing and claim boundary metadata.

allow_clinical_performance_claims.description: Whether FDA-facing clinical performance claims are allowed at this stage.
allow_clinical_performance_claims.title: Allow Clinical Performance Claims

auto_apply_analyte_profile.description: When true (default when primary_analyte is set), merge analyte-specific step_config defaults (fragmentomics, CIS-BP, bisulfite QC, etc.). Set false to opt out.
auto_apply_analyte_profile.title: Auto Apply Analyte Profile

claim_boundary.description: Explicit statement of allowed claims at this stage (e.g. feasibility-only, no final clinical claims).
claim_boundary.title: Claim Boundary

model_training_analyte.description: Analyte matrix used for stability/freeze/classifier training on this project. Defaults to primary_analyte when omitted. Set to cfdna for plasma/cfDNA retrain paths.
model_training_analyte.title: Model Training Analyte

primary_analyte.description: Primary biological analyte for interpretation framing (e.g., buffy_coat, cfdna, combined).
primary_analyte.title: Primary Analyte

stage.description: Current product lifecycle stage for evidence framing.
stage.title: Stage
